summary: Aditxt, Inc. reported that its wholly-owned subsidiary Ignite Proteomics, LLC and Copley Acquisition Corp, a Cayman Islands SPAC, mutually terminated their June 10, 2026 Business Combination Agreement via a Mutual Termination Agreement dated October 9, 2026, effective immediately. No price, stake, premium or closing date was disclosed. All ancillary documents, including seller support agreements, insider letter amendment and lock-up agreements, automatically terminated; each party bears its own expenses and grants mutual releases. Section 8.1(a) governs the termination. Watch for the terminated SPAC deal's impact on Aditxt's financing runway and any refiled transaction or alternative liquidity path.
